scripts.text:
[Dealer]
Hello there! Would you like to play a game of Black Jack?
scripts.translation:
[荷官]
你好！你想玩一局21点吗？

scripts.text:
[Dealer]
What would you like to know?

[Dealer]
Black Jack is a card game in which the goal is to get 21, or as
close to 21 points as possible, without going over 21.
scripts.translation:
[荷官]
21点是一种卡牌游戏，目标是在不超过21点的前提下，尽可能接近或达到21点。

scripts.text:
[Dealer]
Before the game starts, the player must make a bet.  Once the bet
has been made, both the dealer and the player are dealt 2 cards
each.  Depending on what cards you have, you can choose to ^5533FF'stay'^000000,
or you can choose to ^5533FF'pull'^000000.
scripts.translation:
[荷官]
游戏开始前，玩家必须下注。下注后，荷官和玩家各发两张牌。根据你手中的牌，你可以选择^5533FF“停牌”^000000，或者选择^5533FF“要牌”^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dealer]
When you choose to 'stay', you are telling the dealer that you don't
need anymore cards.  This allows the dealer to pull if he/she
wants to.  In order to stay, you must have ^FF3355at least 13 points^000000. The
dealer can only stay when he/she has^FF3355 17 points or more^000000.
scripts.translation:
[荷官]
当你选择“停牌”时，你是在告诉荷官你不需要更多的牌了。这使得荷官可以根据需要继续要牌。要停牌，你必须拥有^FF3355至少13点^000000。荷官只有在拥有^FF335517点或更多^000000时才能停牌。

scripts.text:
[Dealer]
When you choose to 'pull', you are telling the dealer that you want
another card.  By pulling more cards you can increase your point
total.  As long has you have ^FF3355less than 21^000000 points you can pull a
card from the deck.
scripts.translation:
[荷官]
当你选择“要牌”时，你是在告诉荷官你想要另一张牌。通过要更多的牌，你可以增加你的总点数。只要你的点数^FF3355少于21点^000000，你就可以从牌堆中要一张牌。

scripts.text:
[Dealer]
There are 3 ways to win and loose at Black Jack.
scripts.translation:
[荷官]
在21点游戏中，有三种输赢方式。

scripts.text:
[Dealer]
1.) At the end of a Black Jack round, if you have more points
than the dealer you will win the round.  Conversely if you have
less points than the dealer you will loose.
scripts.translation:
[荷官]
1.) 在一局21点结束时，如果你的点数比荷官多，你就赢了这一局。相反，如果你的点数比荷官少，你就输了。

scripts.text:
[Dealer]
2.) If you pull a card that makes your point total go over 21 you
will automatically loose the round.  This is called a ^5533FF'bust'^000000.  If
the dealer busts then you will win the round.
scripts.translation:
[荷官]
2.) 如果你要了一张牌导致总点数超过21点，你将自动输掉这一局。这被称为^5533FF“爆牌”^000000。如果荷官爆牌，那么你就赢了这一局。

scripts.text:
[Dealer]
3.) If you have a point total of 21 with the first 2 cards, you
will automatically win the round.  This is called a ^5533FF'Black Jack'^000000
and happens when you get an 'Ace' and a '10 valued' card. If the
dealer gets a Black Jack he/she will automatically win the round.
scripts.translation:
[荷官]
3.) 如果你前两张牌的总点数为21点，你将自动赢得这一局。这被称为^5533FF“21点”^000000，发生在你拿到一张“A”和一张“10点值”的牌时。如果荷官拿到21点，他/她将自动赢得这一局。

scripts.text:
[Dealer]
4.) Besides winning and loosing, you can tie with the dealer.  If
both you and the dealer have the same point total at the end of a
round, this will result in a tie with no winner and no loss or gain
in money.
scripts.translation:
[荷官]
4.) 除了输赢之外，你还可以与荷官平局。如果在一局结束时，你和荷官的总点数相同，这将导致平局，没有赢家，也没有金钱的损失或收益。

scripts.text:
[Dealer]
This is called a ^5533FF'push'^000000 with the dealer.  This also
applies to both you and the dealer having Black Jack at the same
time.
scripts.translation:
[荷官]
这被称为与荷官^5533FF“推牌”^000000。这也适用于你和荷官同时拥有21点的情况。

scripts.text:
[Dealer]
The 'Double Down' option allows you to double your current bet,
but with the drawback that you will only be able to pull one
additional card.  This option is only available at the beginning of
each round.
scripts.translation:
[荷官]
“加倍下注”选项允许你将当前赌注加倍，但缺点是你只能再要一张牌。此选项仅在每局开始时可用。

scripts.text:
[Dealer]
An example of when doubling down is useful, is when
your first 2 cards give you a point total of 11.  You have a good
chance of getting 21 or 20 with the next card that you draw.  This
would be a good hand to double down on.
scripts.translation:
[荷官]
加倍下注有用的一个例子是，当你前两张牌的总点数为11点时。你很有可能在下一张牌中得到21点或20点。这是一个适合加倍下注的好手牌。

scripts.text:
[Dealer]
The 'Ace' card is a unique card in the game of Black Jack because
it can have 2 values.  An Ace can be counted as either 11 points,
or just 1 point.  For example if you had an Ace and a 4, that would
give you either 15 or 5 points.
scripts.translation:
[荷官]
“A”牌在21点游戏中是一张独特的牌，因为它有两个数值。A可以算作11点，也可以只算作1点。例如，如果你有一张A和一张4，那将是15点或5点。

scripts.text:
[Dealer]
If you decided to stay, the Ace would automatically be counted as
11 points to give you 15 points total.
scripts.translation:
[荷官]
如果你决定停牌，A将自动算作11点，使你的总点数为15点。

scripts.text:
[Dealer]
If you had decided to pull and received a 9, the ace would
automatically be counted as 1 point to give you a total of 14
points.  If the Ace was counted as 11 points, you would have a
point total over 21 and would have lost.
scripts.translation:
[荷官]
如果你决定要牌并得到了一张9，A将自动算作1点，使你的总点数为14点。如果A被算作11点，你的总点数将超过21点，从而导致输局。

scripts.text:
[Dealer]
It is because of the flexibility you have with the 'Ace' that makes
it the most powerful card in the game.
scripts.translation:
[荷官]
正是因为“A”具有这种灵活性，使它成为游戏中最强大的牌。

scripts.text:
[Dealer]
Feel free to come back anytime

[Dealer]
I'm sorry but you don't have enough zeny to make that bet.
scripts.translation:
[荷官]
抱歉，你没有足够的泽尼来下这个注。

[Dealer]
Player has chosen to Double Down.  You're current bet will be
doubled, and you will only be able to pull 1 extra card.
scripts.translation:
[荷官]
玩家选择了加倍下注。你当前的赌注将加倍，并且你只能再要一张牌。

scripts.translation:

平局。你和荷官打平了。
